cues.en: In the previous lecture, we had a brief discussion on why our rule based AI system was not ideal.
cues.zh: 上一堂簡單討論過，為什麼規則式 AI 系統並不理想。

cues.en: Moving forward and moving forward, we shall be using the gradient boosting machine learning model and the reasons as to why we're choosing that model.
cues.zh: 接下來會使用梯度提升機器學習模型，也說明了選擇它的原因。

cues.en: And so to get things started off, we shall create our schema.
cues.zh: 首先要建立 schema。

cues.en: So we're going to go back to back end then up.
cues.zh: 回到 backend，再到 app。

cues.en: Then you're going to go to core.
cues.zh: 接著進入 core。

cues.en: Then within core we're going to create a new folder that's going to be machine learning ML.
cues.zh: 在 core 裡建立機器學習資料夾，命名為 ml。

cues.en: Then within this folder we're going to create double underscore init double underscore dot pi.
cues.zh: 在這個資料夾裡建立 __init__.py。

cues.en: Then we're going to create a new file being models dot pi.
cues.zh: 再建立 models.py。

cues.en: Then create a new file schema.py like that.
cues.zh: 以及 schema.py，像這樣。

cues.en: And before you can proceed, let me just explain again why we're using gradient boosting and how it actually works.
cues.zh: 繼續之前，我再解釋一次為什麼使用梯度提升，以及它實際如何運作。

cues.en: So gradient boosting is basically just like a team of specialists working together, each one fixing the mistakes of those who came before.
cues.zh: 梯度提升就像一組專家共同合作，每一位都修正前面成員的錯誤。

cues.en: So in simple terms, this is how it works.
cues.zh: 用簡單的方式說，它是這樣運作的。

cues.en: First we start with a simple model.
cues.zh: 首先從一個簡單模型開始。

cues.en: And the simple model is usually a single decision tree that makes the initial predictions.
cues.zh: 通常是一棵決策樹，先做出初步預測。

cues.en: And this first set of predictions will often have many errors.
cues.zh: 這第一批預測往往有很多錯誤。

cues.en: Then we go to step two, where we now correct the errors, meaning a second model is trained specifically to correct the mistakes made by this first model that we started with.
cues.zh: 第二步是修正錯誤，也就是專門訓練第二個模型，修正第一個模型犯下的錯誤。

cues.en: Then we do further refinements where a third model is added, this time to correct the remaining errors that the first two models these two couldn't solve.
cues.zh: 接著進一步改善，加入第三個模型，修正前兩個模型尚未解決的錯誤。

cues.en: Then we iteratively improve the model, meaning each new model is focused on the residual errors left by all the previous models.
cues.zh: 然後持續迭代改善，每個新模型都聚焦於前面所有模型留下的殘差。

cues.en: And then lastly, we do the final prediction where all the models are combined to produce the final prediction.
cues.zh: 最後把所有模型組合起來，產生最終預測。

cues.en: Each one is going to contribute a small part and together they form a much more accurate result.
cues.zh: 每個模型各自貢獻一小部分，合起來就能得到準確得多的結果。

cues.en: So in short, gradient boosting is a powerful technique where each model learns from past mistakes, leading to increasingly better performance over time.
cues.zh: 簡單說，梯度提升是一種強大的技術，每個模型都從過去的錯誤學習，讓表現持續改善。

cues.en: That's why I chose the gradient boosting model for fraud detection system.
cues.zh: 這就是我為詐欺偵測系統選擇梯度提升模型的原因。

cues.en: With that being said, now let's go to the schema.py file within backend app core ML.
cues.zh: 接著到 backend/app/core/ml 裡的 schema.py。

cues.zh: 先處理匯入敘述。

cues.zh: 建立模型狀態的列舉，class ModelStatusEnum 繼承 str 和 Enum。

cues.en: Then we're going to have the status of training that's going to be training then ready?
cues.zh: 先有 TRAINING，值為 training，接著是 READY。

cues.en: That's going to be ready.
cues.zh: 值為 ready。

cues.en: Then we'll have deployed.
cues.zh: 再來是 DEPLOYED。

cues.en: That's going to be deployed.
cues.zh: 值為 deployed。

cues.en: Then we'll have failed.
cues.zh: 接著是 FAILED。

cues.en: That's going to be failed, then archived.
cues.zh: 值為 failed，然後是 ARCHIVED。

cues.en: That's going to be archived.
cues.zh: 值為 archived。

cues.en: Then we're going to create the enum for the model type.
cues.zh: 再建立模型類型的列舉。

cues.en: So in future if you want to add more models you're going to add them to this enum.
cues.zh: 以後如果想增加模型，就加進這個列舉。

cues.en: And for documentation purposes you can always navigate to this link on scikit learn on the different models.
cues.zh: 要查看說明文件，可以透過這個 scikit-learn 連結，查看不同模型。

cues.en: Let's go back to our schema.
cues.zh: 回到 schema。

cues.en: So after this model status enum we're going to create another model type enum that's going to be string enum.
cues.zh: 在 ModelStatusEnum 後面，再建立 ModelTypeEnum，同樣繼承 str 和 Enum。

cues.en: Then we're going to be using gradient boosting.
cues.zh: 我們會使用 GRADIENT_BOOSTING。

cues.en: That's going to be gradient boosting.
cues.zh: 值為 gradient_boosting。

cues.en: Then remember if you want to use more models you're going to add them to this enum.
cues.zh: 以後要用更多模型，就加進這個列舉。

cues.en: So for example according to the scikit learn documentation, if you want to use random forest, you can also add it right here to the model type.
cues.zh: 例如依照 scikit-learn 文件，想用隨機森林，也可以加在這裡的模型類型中。

cues.en: But since we're sticking to one model type, we're just going to have gradient boosting.
cues.zh: 但我們只使用一種模型，所以先保留梯度提升。

cues.en: Good.
cues.zh: 很好。
